endpoint.name: Search LinkedIn profiles
endpoint.summary: Search LinkedIn profiles by name, company, location, and more

cost.note: Observed on treg’s prepaid Harvest account. Final platform cost follows the response cost, including billed misses and explicit zero. BYOK never charges the treg balance.

currentCompany.note: Filter by company ID or Company URL. One value or multiple comma-separated

pastCompany.note: Filter by past company ID or Company URL. One value or multiple comma-separated

school.note: Filter by school ID or School URL. One value or multiple comma-separated

geoId.note: Filter by location as LinkedIn Geo ID. Overrides the location query param. Use the /linkedin/geo-id-search endpoint to find the Geo ID

industryId.note: Filter by industry ID. One value or multiple comma-separated

keywordsCompany.note: Filter by keywords in company name

keywordsSchool.note: Filter by keywords in school name

followerOf.note: Filter profiles that are followers of a LinkedIn profile. Provide the profile URL or ID. One value or multiple comma-separated

input.note: Use only the declared query parameters, once each, without a request body. Results are provider-native: inspect element/elements and body status/error; HTTP 200 alone does not prove a hit. Empty results can still be charged. Name searches can work; other searches may return anonymized LinkedIn Member entries without links. Prefer lead search for broader discovery.

endpoint.capability_description: Search people by name or keyword

samples.reason: Title + keywordsSchool + location search returned only anonymized "LinkedIn Member" rows with no URL or public identifier, as the catalog note warns. Billed $0.004.
Exact first+last name search returned a clean zero-hit, which was the right answer for this person lookup.
Name plus location returned the right Denver surgeon profile; many other rows were hidden anonymized members.

provider.limits: Starter: 5 concurrent requests, queue of 10 per Harvest account; no RPM cap. Excess queue requests fail. BYOK uses the customer’s account allowance.

siblings.name: LinkedIn members by name
siblings.summary: The public LinkedIn members with a given first and last name, one row per member: name, profile URL, headline, location, and the company and school summary LinkedIn shows ("Microsoft, +4 more"). For finding the right profile before you read it with linkedin-profile. `first_name` and `last_name` are the name; `limit` caps the members. About 2 s from our own search; about 1 minute when only the second source finds the name. Columns: name, profile_url, profile_id, headline, location, experience, education, avatar.

cost.note: treg's account price: 3.6 credits a call whatever pages the run fetched, second-source records included; a reply with no rows, a refused input and a failed run are free. The x-c4-cost header settles the actual charge.

samples.reason: name search found the right profile, enriched after

siblings.name: Search LinkedIn people by name, title, or company

siblings.call_template: treg call justoneapi.x.linkedin-search-user-v1 --query firstName=Bill --query lastName=Gates --query 'title=Senior Technical Recruiter' --query page=1

cost.note: billed only on success (code 0); errors free

name.note: Name or general keyword to search for.
